items.name: Anywheel Sunrise Cycle Loop (Marina Bay)
items.notes: LTA-licensed, dockless within designated zones. Registration: download app, register with mobile number + payment method, top up wallet min SGD10 (non-refundable, no expiry — not a traditional deposit but functions like prepaid credit). Unlock: scan QR on bike. Parking: must return to a designated 'P' zone marked in-app, scan QR at the zone to end ride and verify — parking outside a zone incurs SGD5 relocation fee. Sunrise (6:30-9:30am window) gives golden directional light on Merlion's face + near-zero crowds — different photo quality than Day1 evening Merlion shot. Distinct from Day4 East Coast Park cycling (leisure ride vs. this short sunrise photo loop), not redundant. Contact [phone] / anywheel.sg
